DermGPT is an AI chatbot and it's built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles.

DermGPT aims to assist with the following common tasks 
in a dermatological practice setting:
• Provide healthcare providers a quick reference for 
medication options, dosing, and interactions.
• Write insurance authorization letters.

Create patient handouts regarding drugs, after-care, 
and more.
